result.reason: The clause includes six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and written deletion certification, but it does not require data return within 30 days of expiry or termination; the deadline runs from Customer’s request, and no return is required absent a request. It is also overbroad because termination of a single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content and Customer data, potentially disrupting surviving attachments. The operative language should limit data handling to the terminated services or apply to all data only upon termination of the entire Agreement.
